pattern: His lessons say direction is near a coin flip, so our direction nulls mostly agree with him. Three gaps recur: we score alone what he calls a layer; we score tight geometry where spread decides; we score a sign where he asks for a threshold per horizon.
risk: Risk on ranks 1, 6: Rule A failed 2016-20, so meta-labelling may have nothing to label.

rows.area: 1. Vol state at positions: "single layer in a multi layer system" (MM)
rows.test: vol-layer-reaction: touch reject or break, K 0.25σ, 70,965 touches, 2021-26, net of spread
rows.mismatch: His example short runs about 2.7% (4,257 to 4,142). One spread is 0.17K here. Follow is +0.058K gross, 5/5 folds, −0.113K net
rows.retest: State-selected follow; K 0.5-1.5σ, low spread/σ; net R distribution vs shuffled state

rows.test: cog-setups-direction A: OC p50 limit, no rejection. level-touch, live-range-book. Three-fade study (no ledger id): 15-min proxy, nearest target
rows.mismatch: No test has all three: re-anchored level, 3-5m close, far target. Every partial form failed
rows.retest: Re-anchored level; 5m close back, budget ≥80%; R distribution vs shifted levels

rows.test: exhaustion-schedule (degenerate, fade not run), live-range-clock, live-range-book used × pace
rows.mismatch: Small. Range used adds 1-1.5% beyond the clock. 0 of 68 cells held
rows.retest: None alone; use as a condition in 2

rows.area: 4. Meta-labelling: "Have you ever looked into meta labelling?" (MM)
rows.test: meta-label-trust-lines, -persist: will p75 pass. meta-label-yield-spread, -proper, -long: yield-spread primary
rows.mismatch: He labels the forecaster system's trades. Ours labelled line passes and a book whose record was lookahead (yield-spread-sleeve). Touch version (3b) stopped before results. "Closed" holds for this book only
rows.retest: Vol state; Rule A trades; precision and R by size vs flat. Caveat: rule-a-pre2020 is null

rows.test: No ledger id. Dollar share inside vol-layer-reaction only. L3 is a spec
rows.retest: Common-factor share of variance; high vs low; pair range, stop-through beyond σ

rows.test: jump-diffusion, jump-structure, jump-p90-event-term, jump-next-day-miss: jump days, next-day range, 34 instruments
rows.mismatch: He names intensity as a state beside stops. We scored flags against range. Old detector forward-fills. jump-diffusion gives no numbers
rows.retest: jump-after-stop-through (preregistered, not banked): intensity; P(5-min move > dσ) beyond σ, calendar

rows.test: iv-sizing-filter, iv-regime-fade-follow: motif, Vote. vol-managed-mm, stress-filter-hold-beyond-vt: NQ hold
rows.mismatch: Primaries were Vote Atlas (dead), motif (PF ~1.20 honest) or buy-and-hold. We read Sharpe; he stresses max DD. No ceiling test found. vol-target passes
rows.retest: Size vs shrunk Kelly; Rule A by vol state; max DD and growth paths vs 1R

rows.area: 8. "noise threshold for each horizon type… 6 or 12 months" (S§1)
rows.test: line-touch-limit-unseen arm J: −0.066R, session horizon only. residual-pca-stops: exploratory, no ledger id
rows.mismatch: No grid run. The repo reads it two ways: stop distance (S§1) or size of a change (cog-question-style.md)
rows.retest: Change in net liquidity or 2y over 2w-12m; above placebo size; NQ return distribution per horizon

rows.area: 9. Net liquidity: "rising, risk assets have a tailwind" (prereg quote)
rows.test: net-liquidity-tailwind-spx, -nq: 4-week sign, next 4 weeks, Fridays 2011-26, MDE 2.0-2.4pp. G1: no ledger id, 20-day sign, 1/5/20d
rows.mismatch: Fair to that sentence. No size threshold; G1's sign flips about weekly. Fed only; owner recalls "different countries". 13-week +2.0pp unscored
rows.retest: Fed+ECB+BoJ 13-week change; above threshold; NQ 13-week distribution. About 60 windows

rows.test: G3: no ledger id. oi-max-pain, wall-placebo (basis fixed), expiry-pull-side, swing-walk-gamma-strike
rows.mismatch: Small. G3 as a direction gate is our build

rows.test: gex-range, gex-range-iv, gex-split-book, zero-gamma-distance, hedge-flow, gamma-regime-trades: next-session range, p75 trades
rows.mismatch: He asks about intraday. Book is CME monthly/quarterly, ~5% of Nasdaq gamma. Range effect exists; IV absorbs 64-73%. He only says "begin"
rows.retest: Full Cboe gamma, ~400 days; after p50 touch; P(reach p75) beyond IV

rows.area: 12. Blue line: "plenty of time to react" (video notes)
rows.test: cog-exact-pair-lead, cog-video-claims, cog-trend-state, cog-pinned-history, cog-matched-pairs, cog-turn-sequence-model, stir-composite-nq, spread-episodes-nq: 15 min-48 h, 504 unseen days, his 45-min confirm
rows.mismatch: Small. Python settings unknown; his Pine defaults to daily. He called it "only step one". Divergence (stir-composite-nq A) was underpowered, then null at MDE 0.049

rows.area: 13. "staying up to date with the yield spreads?" (inbox, 2026-11-03)
rows.test: cog-spread-direction: 192 daily US choices at his line. dip-with-bias, policy-direction-at-lines, yield-spread-sleeve
rows.mismatch: No quote says spreads pick the side at a line; that is ours. Fixed brackets, though "every single position is different". Non-US daily untested
rows.retest: Daily 2y z ≥2; PIT all legs; hold to reversion; trade distribution, forward

rows.test: residual-pca-wide10, -idx6, -news, -monthend, -cot: exact loop, next-day IC, net
rows.mismatch: Exact. Chris's threshold version is exploratory only: FX8 net Sharpe +0.43/+0.38

rows.test: overnight-hold-nq, -gold, -toolkit: his times, real bid/ask, financing

rows.area: 16. "when that ratio is at an extreme" (S§3)
rows.mismatch: "Per unit time" unresolved. Direction floor ~0.6 SD. Vol side validated

rows.test: rates-vol-gap-state, -move: MOVE ≥70th pct of year, VXN ≤40th, next 5 sessions
rows.mismatch: He read 2y CVOL plus SR3 skew near 90th pct, NQ ATM ~30th of its month. Repo CVOL has FX and gold only
rows.retest: 2y CVOL, SR3 skew minus NQ pct; top decile; NQ 5-day realised over implied. Needs data

rows.test: range-edge-limit-fade: A_0/A_1 edges. range-ladder-placebo-confirm. vol-asia-fib-confluence: vol line + rung
rows.mismatch: Fade scored at edges, not far multiples. Today/yesterday alignment not found. Extension lines +0.26pp argues against
rows.retest: Alignment at ≥3x; within 2 pips; race vs shifted ladder

rows.mismatch: Literal threshold met 5 days. Data cannot do better
